description: This file contains serialization and copying logic for array-like structures such as T[], ReadOnlyMemory<T>, Memory<T>, ArraySegment<T>. It defines serializers and deep copiers for these types as part of the Orleans serialization framework.

classes.name: ArrayCodec<T>
classes.description: Serializer for one-dimensional arrays of type T[]. Handles serialization and deserialization, including reference management and length encoding.

classes.name: ArrayCopier<T>
classes.description: Deep copier implementation for arrays of type T[]. Creates deep copies of arrays with element-wise copying.

classes.name: ReadOnlyMemoryCodec<T>
classes.description: Serializer for ReadOnlyMemory<T>. Supports serialization including reference management when possible.

classes.name: ReadOnlyMemoryCopier<T>
classes.description: Deep copier for ReadOnlyMemory<T>. Implements deep copy logic for such memory structures.

classes.name: MemoryCodec<T>
classes.description: Serializer for Memory<T>. Handles serialization similar to ReadOnlyMemory<T>.

classes.name: ArraySegmentCodec<T>
classes.description: Serializer for ArraySegment<T>. Serializes the segment with length info and handles references.

classes.name: ArraySegmentCopier<T>
classes.description: Deep copier for ArraySegment<T>. Creates a new segment with an internal deep-copied array.

methods.name: WriteField
methods.description: Serializes the array or memory structure, with reference handling and length encoding.

methods.name: ReadValue
methods.description: Deserializes the array or memory structure, reconstructing the object and handling references.

methods.name: DeepCopy
methods.description: Performs a deep copy of the array or memory structure, element-wise.
